This is an original, intentionally small compatibility implementation of the four unsigned conversion functions consumed by `@solana/buffer-layout-utils`. It replaces the unmaintained native addon affected by GHSA-3gc7-fjrx-p6mg. It always uses JavaScript BigInt, never native bindings, bounds allocations to 1,024 bytes, and rejects overflow rather than truncating. SPL layouts use 8–32 bytes. Tests compare against Node Buffer's independent 64-bit conversions and exercise both endian directions, overflow and 128/256-bit boundaries. This is not an upstream release. Keep the npm override and tests together.
